_about: Compatibility is keyed by 3DS program ID. Top-level profiles preserve Wii U build settings. _wiiu and _cemu add display-only results. Cemu entries default to Plays and can be marked Limited for setup or short smoke checks. Complete is reserved for finished Wii U verification. mixed selects the safe video decoder for the tested base edition.
